themes.theme: Apple Watch interval haptics too weak to feel mid-workout
themes.hook: You miss the wrist tap mid-sprint: why Apple Watch interval alerts get lost during hard efforts and how to make cues you actually notice.
themes.evidence: Reddit skipped: no OAuth creds at config/reddit-oauth.json. iMore watchOS thread calls the interval haptic a very weak vibration that is often missed; Apple Community thread on intervals giving no alert at switches; competitor listings (HIIT Workouts, Pulse) now advertise stronger escalating haptics.
pain_quotes: The vibration for the next interval is so faint I miss it every time I'm running hard
My watch never told me the interval changed, I only noticed when I looked
I want a stronger buzz for the last round, not the same tiny tap
themes.distinctFrom: best-apple-watch-interval-timer answers which Watch timer app to pick; this answers why the haptic cue itself goes unnoticed (Prominent haptics, wrist fit, motion masking, pairing haptic with audio, countdown pre-warnings) whatever app you use.
themes.searchEvidence: Pain-signal theme; adjacent Watch posts earn impressions (apple-watch-interval-timer-without-phone 17 imp pos 11, best-apple-watch-interval-timer 27 imp pos 25 in last 28 days).

themes.theme: Bouldering 4x4 timer: four problems, four rounds, timed rest
themes.hook: The climbers' 4x4 builds power endurance only if the rest stays honest; how long to rest between sets and how to time it so it doesn't drift.
themes.evidence: Reddit skipped: no OAuth creds at config/reddit-oauth.json. Search Console shows climbers already reaching the site ('climbing hiit classes') with no climbing post published; hangboard-repeaters-timer is queued for finger strength, the 4x4 is the wall-conditioning counterpart.
pain_quotes: My rest between 4x4 sets turns into ten minutes of chatting
I never know if I should rest after each problem or only between sets
Hard to keep count of which round I'm on when I'm pumped
themes.distinctFrom: norwegian-4x4-interval-timer is a 4:00/3:00 cardio protocol; this is the climbing 4x4 (four boulder problems back to back, four sets, timed rest) and how to time set-ends you finish by hand. Distinct from queued hangboard-repeaters-timer (7/3 finger hangs).

The Workout app tracks laps but won't tell me when to leave the wall
I end up counting seconds in my head between 100s

themes.theme: Tabata song vs a Tabata timer app
themes.hook: Tabata songs bake the 20/10 cues into the track; when that is all you need and when a timer over your own music works better.
themes.evidence: Reddit skipped: no OAuth creds at config/reddit-oauth.json. Tabata Songs app sells 43 cue-baked tracks behind an in-app purchase; Totally Tabata reviews complain switching apps to change a song pauses the timer, the exact choice this post settles.
pain_quotes: I love the Tabata song but I'm sick of the same track every session
Can I use my own playlist and still know when the 20 seconds is up
The song only works for one 4-minute round, what about the rest of the workout

themes.theme: 10-20-30 running timer with three paces inside one minute
themes.hook: The 10-20-30 run is 30 seconds easy, 20 moderate and 10 all-out, five times, then a walk — a work/rest timer cannot name the three paces
themes.evidence: Reddit OAuth, xpoz, Google Search Console and Keyword Planner skipped (not available in this cloud environment); web search only. Runlovers lays out the minute as 30 easy, 20 moderate and 10 all-out, five times without stopping, then about 2 minutes easy, for 3–4 sets; Futurity describes beginners starting at one 5-minute block and fitter runners at two blocks with a 3–4 minute break; Runner's World reports the same protocol in a performance study.
pain_quotes: I lose which of the three speeds I am in because they all live inside the same minute
A normal interval timer only has work and rest, and this run has three efforts plus a set break
I end up counting the 10-second sprint in my head and the rest of the minute falls apart
themes.distinctFrom: interval-running-workout-timer (0.27) builds a generic run — warm-up, equal hard/easy repeats, cool-down — as one audio timer; this answers how to encode the 10-20-30 minute (30 easy, 20 moderate, 10 sprint, five times, then a walk), which a single work/rest repeat cannot name. walk-run-interval-timer is a two-pace week-by-week ratio, not three efforts inside one minute
themes.searchEvidence: Reddit OAuth, xpoz, Google Search Console and Keyword Planner skipped (not available in this cloud environment); web search only. No impressions or keyword volume. Pain signal from runlovers.it, futurity.org and runnersworld.com descriptions of the 10-20-30 protocol.

themes.theme: Fight Gone Bad timer: five one-minute stations and one minute off
themes.hook: Fight Gone Bad is one minute at each of five stations with the clock still running, then one minute off, three rounds, and the score is reps
themes.evidence: Reddit OAuth, xpoz, Google Search Console and Keyword Planner skipped (not available in this cloud environment); web search only. pain_quotes: A rest beep in the middle of the five minutes ruins the round, because the clock is not supposed to stop between stations
Every minute sounds the same, so I lose which station I am on
The score is total reps, not a finish time, and a for-time clock does not tell me when to move

themes.theme: Gibala sprint interval timer: 30 seconds on, four minutes easy
themes.hook: The Gibala sprint interval is 30 seconds all-out and about four minutes easy, four to seven times — a Tabata timer and a repeating 30-second beep both run the wrong clock
themes.evidence: Reddit OAuth, xpoz, Google Search Console and Keyword Planner skipped (not available in this cloud environment); web search only. pain_quotes: The recovery is so long I start the next sprint early or late because nothing calls me back
A Tabata timer is twenty on and ten off, which is a different session entirely
A beep every 30 seconds keeps firing through the four-minute recovery, which is the opposite of what I need

themes.theme: Cluster set timer with a short rest inside the set
themes.hook: A cluster set needs 15–20 seconds between mini-sets and a normal multi-minute rest after the cluster, and a rest timer only runs one of those clocks
themes.evidence: Reddit OAuth, xpoz, Google Search Console and Keyword Planner skipped (not available in this cloud environment); web search only. Muscle & Fitness programs hypertrophy clusters as 4+4+4 with 15–20 seconds between clusters, or 20–30 seconds on heavier setups; Sci-Fit specifies 15–45 seconds between sub-sets and then a normal 2–4 minute rest; The Barbell describes the same 15–20 second intra-set break that lifters otherwise count in their heads.
pain_quotes: I count the twenty seconds in my head and it is never actually twenty
My rest timer only starts after the whole set, so the short breaks inside the set are guesswork
By the last cluster the short rest has stretched and the point of the cluster is gone
themes.distinctFrom: Closest scored neighbour is emom-meaning at 0.15, which explains what a one-minute EMOM window is. This answers a different clock: 15–20 seconds between mini-sets inside a cluster, then the normal multi-minute rest after the cluster. rest-timer-between-sets only covers that long rest between whole sets
